name: uncalibrated interchange structural experiment
description: a reproducible reference-runtime exploration of one explicitly authored interchange configuration

assumptions.subject: passengers.speed
assumptions.rationale: the authored walking speed is a transparent structural input, not a calibrated population estimate

assumptions.subject: fare_gate.capacity
assumptions.rationale: the service rate is an explicit analytical constraint and not an observed facility throughput

assumptions.subject: fare_gate_reduced.capacity at 30 seconds
assumptions.rationale: the scheduled reduction is an explicit operational stress condition and not a claim about staffing, equipment reliability, or observed throughput

assumptions.subject: passengers.release, passengers.release_interval, and passengers.release_batch_size
assumptions.rationale: the deterministic one-second cadence in four-person pulses exposes a staged-demand condition without claiming an observed arrival process

assumptions.subject: passengers.radius and passengers.height
assumptions.rationale: the reference runtime needs declared body dimensions but this example does not claim a population profile

claim_boundary: This is an uncalibrated deterministic structural experiment. It does not predict a real facility, population, evacuation outcome, operational response, or safety result.
